scripts.build: tsc -b packages/charts --force && npm run build:primitives && npm run build --workspace @kind-ui/ai
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run check:tooling && npm run check:types && npm run check:apps-tooling
scripts.check: npm run check:fast && npm run check:chart
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.check:chart: npm run check:packed && node scripts/run-checks.mjs consumers
scripts.check:release: node --test scripts/tooling-schemas.test.mjs scripts/release-artifact.test.mjs scripts/release-workflow.test.mjs scripts/release-plan.test.mjs scripts/github-release.test.mjs && node scripts/check-release-versioning.mjs
scripts.check:framework: npm run check:line-integrations && npm run test:line-integrations
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/chart.test.mjs tests/chart-frame.test.mjs tests/activity-rings.test.mjs tests/tailwind-classes.test.mjs tests/compound-chart.test.mjs && npm run test:primitives && npm run test:ai
scripts.check:fast: node scripts/run-checks.mjs preflight && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.check:packed: npm run check:primitives:package && npm run pack:artifact && tsc -p tests/fixtures/browser && node scripts/check-browser-fixtures.mjs && npm run check:line-integrations && npm run build:registry && npm run check:registry-consumers && npm run check:ai:package
scripts.check:types: tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p tests/fixtures/primitives && npm run check:ai:types
scripts.check:registry: npm run build:registry && node --test scripts/registry-contract.test.mjs apps/showcase/scripts/hosting.test.mjs
scripts.test:primitives: node --test tests/primitives.test.mjs tests/table.test.mjs tests/dialog.test.mjs tests/combobox.test.mjs tests/hover-card.test.mjs
scripts.check:primitives:package: npm run build:primitives:registry && node --test tests/primitives-source.test.mjs && node scripts/check-primitives-package.mjs
scripts.build:ai: npm run build:primitives && npm run build --workspace @kind-ui/ai
scripts.check:ai:types: tsc -p tests/fixtures/ai-answers && tsc -p packages/ai/tests/tsconfig.context-research.json && tsc -p packages/ai/tests/tsconfig.context-research.json --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler
scripts.check:ai: npm run build:ai && npm run test:ai && npm run check:ai:types && npm run check:ai:package
